evals.name: standard-session-wrap-up
evals.prompt: I'm wrapping up this session. Run /handoff so another agent can continue where we left off.
evals.expected_output: A <prefix>-handoff-<suffix>.md artifact in the artifact dir with git status, completed items, and numbered next steps for /proceed.

assertions.name: captures_git_state
assertions.text: Artifact includes git branch and commit information

assertions.name: has_numbered_next_steps
assertions.text: Artifact includes concrete numbered next steps

assertions.name: has_proceed_gate
assertions.text: Artifact ends with Next Step Gate instructing /proceed <artifact>

assertions.name: includes_chat_link_block
assertions.text: Chat response includes an artifact-protocol link block

evals.name: focused-feature-handoff
evals.prompt: Run /handoff fix-auth-token-refresh to prepare the next session specifically for fixing auth token refresh edge cases.
evals.expected_output: A <prefix>-handoff-fix-auth-token-refresh.md artifact in the artifact dir tailored to auth token refresh with numbered next steps for /proceed.

assertions.name: uses_specified_suffix
assertions.text: Artifact filename or header uses suffix fix-auth-token-refresh

assertions.name: tailors_next_steps_to_focus
assertions.text: Next steps specifically address auth token refresh

assertions.name: has_proceed_gate
assertions.text: Artifact ends with Next Step Gate instructing /proceed <artifact>
